sources.source_name: Diário da República Online (DRON), I Série
sources.jurisdiction_coverage: Angola; Diário da República I Série
sources.access_method: Public web search/filter and view/download PDF; no login stated
sources.observed_availability: Accessible on 2026-11-03; portal described free consultation/download and listed editions (site content observed by web search)
sources.reliability_notes: Official portal explicitly labels the hosted I Série PDFs as official. Portal states II and III Series remain through Imprensa Nacional channels; verify those separately. Edition coverage observed as partial, so absence is not evidence of non-publication.
sources.reuse_copyright_notes: Consultation/download availability is not a redistribution licence. Store source link and permitted metadata only; check each document's rights before copying.

sources.source_name: Assembleia Nacional — legislação e atividade parlamentar
sources.jurisdiction_coverage: Angola; parliamentary legislation, legislative process and parliamentary records
sources.access_method: Public HTML pages; linked documents may be PDF
sources.observed_availability: Accessible via official domain; legislation page and approved-diplomas navigation observed on 2026-11-03
sources.reliability_notes: Primary institutional source for parliamentary materials and legislative history. Approval by Parliament does not alone establish promulgation/publication or current force; check gazette.
sources.reuse_copyright_notes: Link and metadata only unless specific reuse terms authorize copying; PDFs may have rights or privacy restrictions.

sources.jurisdiction_coverage: Angola; parliamentary and institutional documents and research

sources.observed_availability: Accessible on 2026-11-03; portal identifies itself as Assembleia Nacional digital library and offers legislative records
sources.reliability_notes: Official institutional repository for hosted material; distinguish parliamentary records from enacted law and verify law against Diário da República.
sources.reuse_copyright_notes: Repository access does not establish open licence for documents. Link/metadata only absent explicit reuse terms.

sources.access_method: Public HTML jurisprudence pages and linked documents

sources.reliability_notes: Official court portal; check each decision's metadata and any anonymization/context before cataloguing. Published decisions are not legislation.
sources.reuse_copyright_notes: Do not assume website publication permits redistribution; retain citations/links and assess personal data and document terms.

sources.access_method: Public HTML categories and linked decision files (including PDFs)

sources.reuse_copyright_notes: Link/metadata only unless reuse terms permit copies; review privacy and personal data in decisions.

sources.source_name: Portal Oficial do Governo de Angola — documentos/legislação
sources.jurisdiction_coverage: Angola; executive documents and legislative materials linked by government
sources.access_method: Public web pages; documents section offers legislation and document categories
sources.observed_availability: Accessible on 2026-11-03; official portal and Documents/Legislação navigation observed
sources.reliability_notes: Official executive source for items it publishes; use Diário da República to verify authoritative promulgated text and publication status.

sources.institution: United Nations, Office of Legal Affairs, Treaty Section
